title: GitHub panel
brief: Rebuild the right-side GitHub panel of the Herdr Desktop sidebar (~380 px, next to Files/Changes) so it answers per repo of the active space: what needs my action, what is moving, what is broken, and issues triaged by meaning, with real affordances (review, checkout into new space, copy, re-run failed jobs). RefactorIA tokens from 04-sessions-v2, calm colours, AA contrast.

artboards.title: Action inbox
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest answer to 'what needs me' in one feed (reviews, changes requested, mentions, broken CI with its first error inline); tabs become filter chips, so browsing all PRs or all 21 issues is one click further away and the order shifts as items change

artboards.title: Rich tabs
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar PRs/Issues/CI/Inbox model with the richest per-PR card (checks, reviewers, size, merge state) and inline expansion showing checks, files and all actions; urgency is split across tabs (attention dots only), and three-line cards fit ~6 PRs per screen

artboards.title: Repo dashboard
artboards.tradeoff: A health card (main CI, failing branch, queue sizes) gives instant orientation and issues are grouped by meaning (assigned, approved, bugs, stale); the fixed section order means a long review queue pushes CI and issues below the fold, and the card costs ~130 px
